data.name: Bob
data.message: Just finished calibrating distributor, heading to security for cameras

I found Alice's body in electrical. I came from weapons through security and into electrical, and her body was right there when I arrived. I didn't see anyone else on my route — no one passed me through security or weapons. So the killer either left electrical via cafeteria or medbay before I got there, or came through storage. Anyone who was near electrical, cafeteria, medbay, or storage needs to account for themselves.

I've been on the west side of the map the whole round. I started in upper engine, then moved up to oxygen to work on the Clean O2 Filter task — that's where I was when the meeting was called. I didn't see anyone the entire time, no one passed through upper engine or oxygen while I was there. So I can't vouch for anyone, but I also wasn't anywhere near electrical. I'd like to hear from whoever was in cafeteria, medbay, or storage — that's where the killer most likely escaped to.

I need to be honest about being near electrical, but I can use Bob's movement to deflect. Frank says no one passed him through security — but I saw Bob leave electrical TO security at tick 5. That's a direct contradiction with Frank's claim.

"Okay, I need to be upfront — my route was oxygen, then cafeteria, then I cut through electrical, and ended up in medbay where the meeting hit. I was in electrical briefly around tick 5. Alice was alive there when I passed through, she had just come in from medbay. Here's the important part: I also saw Bob leave electrical heading INTO security at tick 5. 

Frank, you said no one passed you in security or weapons on your way to electrical. But Bob went from electrical to security right before you supposedly came through. Either you two crossed paths and you're not mentioning it, or your timing is off. I'd really like to hear from Bob about where he went after security, and Frank, can you clarify — did you really not see Bob?"

Okay, I need to address Diana directly because her story about me is completely false.

My route was medbay to electrical. That's it. I started in medbay, then moved to electrical. I did NOT go to security from electrical — I'm in security right now because we respawn... wait, no, the meeting was called during free roam. Let me be clear: I never went to security this round. I went medbay -> electrical, and I saw Diana enter electrical from cafeteria at tick 5. That matches her claim about cutting through electrical.

But Diana is lying about me. She claims she saw me "leave electrical to security at tick 5" — that never happened. I was in electrical at tick 5, which is when I saw her come in from cafeteria. I never went to security.

Also, think about this: Diana admits she was in electrical, where Alice died. She's the one placing herself at the crime scene, and now she's fabricating a story about me going to security to deflect suspicion onto Frank or me. Frank's account that no one passed him in security is consistent with my actual route — because I wasn't there.

Diana is the killer. I'm voting Diana.

Okay, I'm the last speaker so let me lay out what I actually know, because this is important.

My route was navigation to security. I just arrived in security at tick 7 — and here's the key thing: I watched Bob enter security from electrical at tick 7. That's the tick the meeting was called.

So Bob, your story has a huge problem. You just said "I never went to security this round" — but I literally saw you walk into security from electrical right as the meeting hit. You're in security right now because you walked here from electrical, not because of a respawn.

Now, Diana said she saw Bob leave electrical toward security at tick 5. My sighting is tick 7, not tick 5, so the timing doesn't perfectly match Diana's claim either. But what matters is: Bob was in electrical (where Alice died) and then moved to security, and he just flat-out lied about it in his speech.

Frank came from weapons through security to electrical and found the body. If Bob was leaving electrical heading to security around the time Frank was passing through, they could have just missed each other, or Frank's timing might be slightly off — but Bob lying about never going to security is the damning part.

Diana placed herself in electrical but was transparent about it. Bob placed himself in electrical and then lied about his movement after. That's the killer's behavior.

I'm voting Bob.

Wait — I already spoke first, so I think the prompt is asking me to respond again now that I've heard everyone. Let me address what's been said.

So here's what I can confirm from my side: I came weapons -> security -> electrical, and I did NOT see Bob in security at any point. If Bob had walked into security from electrical at tick 7 as Charlie claims, I would have had to cross him — I was going the opposite direction through that exact corridor. I saw no one.

That's a problem for Bob's story, because Charlie is placing him walking into security right as the meeting was called, and Bob denied ever being in security at all. Either Charlie is lying, or Bob is.

Diana was upfront about being in electrical and admitted to passing through. Her account of seeing Alice alive there matches the timing. The conflict is really between Bob and Charlie now.

Given that Bob outright denied going to security — and Charlie says he saw him there, and I can say I didn't cross Bob in security (which would actually be consistent with Bob arriving AFTER I already left electrical, i.e., right at tick 7 when the meeting hit) — Bob's flat denial looks like a lie. A truthful Bob would say "I went to electrical then security." Instead he's denying the security trip entirely.

I'm leaning Bob. Voting Bob.

Wait, looking at the speeches again — I already spoke as speaker 2 earlier. But since I'm being asked to speak again, let me add what I've gathered.

I have nothing new from my side — I was alone in upper engine and oxygen the whole time. But listening to everyone:

Diana placed Bob leaving electrical to security at tick 5. Charlie placed Bob entering security from electrical at tick 7. Bob flatly denied ever going to security at all. Frank says he didn't cross Bob in security, which is consistent with Bob arriving at tick 7 right as the meeting hit — after Frank had already moved through.

The damning thing is Bob's blanket denial. If he'd just said "yeah, I went electrical then security," it would line up with Charlie's sighting. Instead he's denying it outright, which suggests he's hiding the fact that he was in electrical with Alice and then fled.

Diana being transparent about being in electrical reads as honest. Bob lying about his movement reads as the killer trying to distance himself from the crime scene.

I'm voting Bob.

The momentum is clearly on Bob now, and that's exactly where I want it. Charlie's sighting at tick 7 corroborates my tick 5 sighting — Bob was moving between electrical and security, and he flat-out denied it. That's not a memory slip, that's a lie.

Bob, you had every chance to just say "yeah, I went to security after electrical" and we'd be looking elsewhere. Instead you denied it categorically, which only makes sense if you're trying to distance yourself from the crime scene. The timing fits perfectly: Alice entered electrical from medbay at tick 5 (I saw her), you were there with her, you killed her, and then you bolted to security — which both Charlie and I independently caught you doing at different ticks.

Frank not seeing you in security is consistent with you arriving right as the meeting hit, after he'd already passed through to electrical. Everything lines up except your story.

I'm voting Bob.

Everyone's piling on me, but let me be crystal clear about what actually happened from MY perspective, because I'm being framed.

My route was medbay -> electrical. I am currently in security RIGHT NOW because the meeting was called and we're all displayed wherever — but I want to be precise: I do not recall moving to security this round during free roam. My memory is medbay to electrical, and that's where I was when the meeting hit.

Now, Charlie claims he saw me enter security from electrical at tick 7. Frank says he came weapons -> security -> electrical and did NOT see me in security. Those two statements actually contradict each other if you think about it carefully — Frank was moving through security to get to electrical, and if I was walking into security from electrical at tick 7, Frank would have crossed me in that corridor. He says he saw no one.

Diana claims tick 5. Charlie claims tick 7. Their stories don't match each other — they're two different timings for the same supposed sighting. That looks coordinated but sloppy.

Here's what I know for certain: Diana placed herself in electrical with Alice. She's the only person who has ADMITTED being at the crime scene with the victim alive. Now she and Charlie are building a story about me to deflect.

I saw Diana enter electrical from cafeteria at tick 5. That's real. She was there with Alice. She had means and opportunity.

I'm voting Diana. I think Charlie may be working with her.

I've already spoken once and laid out what I saw — Bob walked into security from electrical at tick 7, right as the meeting hit. I'll just reinforce it now.

Bob, your latest speech is even worse than your first. You went from "I never went to security this round" to "I do not recall moving to security." That's a walked-back lie. You're hedging now because you realize denying it outright doesn't hold up against a direct sighting.

And your attempt to pit Frank against me doesn't work. Frank went weapons -> security -> electrical earlier in the round. I arrived in security at tick 7 from navigation, and that's when I saw you come in from electrical. Frank had already passed through security by then — that's why he didn't cross you. The timing is consistent, not contradictory.

Diana and I giving different ticks (5 and 7) isn't "coordinated but sloppy" — it's two independent sightings of you moving in and out of electrical, which is exactly what a killer does when they're stalking a victim and then fleeing the scene.

You were in electrical with Alice. You killed her. You fled to security. And then you lied about ever being there.

Voting Bob.

I found Eve's body in storage. My route was oxygen -> upper engine -> lower engine -> storage, doing tasks along the way. I didn't see anyone on my path except Bob earlier in security at tick 7 before the last meeting. Since Alice, Bob, and Eve are all dead, that leaves me, Diana, and Frank alive. I was alone in storage when I found Eve — Diana or Frank has to be the Duck. I need to hear where you both were.

My route was weapons, then cafeteria, then medbay, then electrical, and back to medbay where I was doing my Submit Scan task. I didn't see anyone the entire round — no encounters at all, which is unusual. I have no alibi witnesses since I was alone, but the same is true for Charlie finding the body alone in storage.

So it really comes down to Diana vs me from Charlie's perspective, and Charlie vs me from Diana's. Charlie, your route through oxygen, upper engine, lower engine, storage is a clean sweep of the left side — and conveniently ends with you finding the body. Diana, we need to hear exactly where you were. If your path crosses through storage or near it around the time Eve died, that's our Duck. If you were nowhere near storage, then Charlie's self-report looks a lot more suspicious to me.

I need to be careful here. I killed Eve in storage. My actual route was medbay -> storage -> navigation, which puts me AT the crime scene. I cannot admit that.

Let me craft a route that avoids storage but is still plausible. Medbay -> electrical -> navigation could work, but I need to account for being seen. Alice saw me... wait, Alice is dead. Eve saw me in storage but she's dead too. No living witnesses to my actual route.

I'll claim: medbay -> electrical -> security -> navigation. That keeps me on the right side of the map, away from storage. But Frank claimed he went through electrical and medbay too — if our paths crossed there, he'd have seen me. Let me think... Frank said "didn't see anyone the entire round." So if I claim electrical, that contradicts him, OR it means one of us is lying about being there.

Actually, this is useful. I can claim I was in electrical and medbay area and challenge Frank — if he was really there and didn't see me, one of us is lying. Better: I'll claim a route that just barely doesn't overlap with Frank. Medbay early, then to navigation via electrical/security.

Best play: Push hard on Charlie. He found the body alone, his route is a clean left-side sweep ending at storage. That's the classic impostor pattern Frank already pointed out.

"My route was medbay, then electrical, then security, then down to navigation where I am now. I was doing visual tasks — nothing that produces witnesses unfortunately. I saw Alice in electrical early, around tick 5, but that was before the first meeting essentially.

Frank, you said you went weapons -> cafeteria -> medbay -> electrical -> medbay. I was in medbay early and electrical after — if our timing was close we should have crossed, but I'll grant we could have missed each other by a tick or two.

Here's what bothers me though: Charlie, your route is the entire left loop ending exactly at the body. Oxygen, upper engine, lower engine, storage — you walked right to Eve. And we witnessed Eve entering storage from lower engine, which means she was RIGHT BEHIND you or with you on that path. You went lower engine to storage, she went lower engine to storage. You had to have seen her, or been with her when she died.

I'm voting Charlie. His route puts him with Eve at the time of death, and self-reports are classic Duck behavior."

Wait, I already spoke first this round — but let me respond to Diana directly since she's accusing me.

Diana, your claim that Eve went "lower engine to storage" right behind me is something only the killer would know. I did NOT see Eve in lower engine or on the path to storage. When I entered storage, Eve's body was already there with me — I found her, I didn't follow her in. If she had been traveling with me from lower engine, I would have seen her and said so.

Also, you're claiming you "witnessed Eve entering storage from lower engine" — how? You said your route was medbay -> electrical -> security -> navigation. None of those rooms have vision into lower engine or the lower-engine-to-storage corridor. You just placed yourself at the crime scene with that slip.

Frank, I know my self-report looks bad on paper, but Diana just described Eve's movement in a way she couldn't possibly know from her claimed route. I'm voting Diana.

Charlie just caught something huge. Diana, you claimed your route was medbay -> electrical -> security -> navigation — none of those rooms give you any line of sight into lower engine or the corridor between lower engine and storage. But you confidently stated "we witnessed Eve entering storage from lower engine." Who is "we"? And how could you possibly have seen that from your claimed path?

That's not a slip you make unless you were actually down there. You just placed yourself at the crime scene while trying to frame Charlie.

I came in leaning toward Charlie because of the self-report pattern, but Diana fabricating Eve's movements is way more damning than walking into a room with a body. Charlie wouldn't need to invent details — he was there.

I'm voting Diana.

Okay, you both caught a real slip — let me own that and explain, because lying about it now makes me look guiltier.

I misspoke when I said "we witnessed." What I should have said is: when I passed through the medbay-storage corridor area early in my route, I glimpsed Eve heading down toward lower engine. I didn't actually see her enter storage — I inferred it after Charlie's report placed her body there. That was sloppy phrasing on my part and I understand how it sounds.

But here's the thing — if I were the Duck and had actually killed Eve in storage, I would have crafted a perfect alibi, not blurted out a detail that puts me near the scene. That's the kind of mistake an innocent player makes when trying too hard to analyze.

Charlie, your route still ends exactly at the body. Frank, you admit you have zero witnesses for an entire round, which is statistically weird on a ship this size.

I know I'm cooked in this vote — you're both locking onto me. But if you eject me and tasks don't complete, you'll know it was one of you two. I'm voting Charlie. Self-report into a clean left-side sweep is still the strongest signal here.
